key_findings.title: Repo-as-database
key_findings.evidence: /operator write routes and server actions write git-tracked JSON (staffordos/events/*, snapshots, proof_runs); the local untracked ADR_0001 artifact concedes file-backed surfaces are not durable on Render
key_findings.correction: Execute ADR_0001: move runtime truth to Postgres; Git keeps code, doctrine, sealed evidence exports

key_findings.title: Duplicated truth
key_findings.evidence: >=11 lead/merchant/client/contact stores reconciled at read time by relationshipResolver.ts with explicit conflict states; 3 decision stores; 3+ action stores; 4 evidence representations; 3 mission-ID namespaces; triple-defined workspace taxonomy
key_findings.correction: Single persistence authority per object; Party/Relationship consolidation; mission-namespace reconciliation doc

key_findings.title: Identity built but unplugged
key_findings.evidence: operator-issuer (EdDSA JWT, roles) + Prisma StaffordosOperator* models + web verifier exist; observed write-capable UI surfaces include 5 POST API routes and 10 server-action directives; issuer permissions all shopifixer.*; role maps duplicated in two codebases
key_findings.correction: Minimal token on write endpoints now (or accepted-risk record while local-only); deploy issuer + generalize permissions before any second user

key_findings.title: Static registries vs runtime truth divergence
key_findings.evidence: All S008 foundations are hardcoded TS arrays with no write path; one real private job opportunity exists on disk while committed UI permanently renders empty queue
key_findings.correction: asOf/freshness labeling; governed read-model adapters (S009_05 pattern) as the only wiring path

key_findings.title: Uncommitted authority chain
key_findings.evidence: J001 discovery docs (cited by committed J001_01), operator-issuer, M007/M008/RECOVERY_001 records, and many other governance artifacts are untracked; A001 validation observed 153 untracked paths before review ratification; same pattern flagged in P11.58
key_findings.correction: Containment commit wave; treat cited-authority-must-be-committed as a gate rule

key_findings.title: Private-data defense is single-layer
key_findings.evidence: Code guards reject repo-internal private paths (privateCareerEvidenceIntake.ts, privateJobOpportunityIntake.ts); zero private files tracked; but no .gitignore entries for *.private.json, staffordos-private-intake/, .staffordos/

key_findings.title: Professional registry contradiction
key_findings.evidence: workspaceRegistry.ts says Professional 'planned / no runtime workflow yet' while /os/professional/jobs ships as Available now (J001_01)
key_findings.correction: Update registry; add professionalMode field (job_search|my_job|mode_neutral) to Professional contracts

key_findings.title: Asset/file authority absent and needed before Media
key_findings.evidence: Evidence manifest contains machine-specific /var/folders temp paths with exists:false; 4 evidence representations; no asset model
key_findings.correction: Adopt Asset model per review section 12 before any Personal/Media implementation

before_more_job_search: fix Professional registry contradiction + professionalMode field
governed read-adapter rule for jobs queue wiring
minimal auth on write endpoints or accepted-risk record
